title: Evaluation beside the field
question: Choose the working sheet for a verified player. Every option keeps the same finder, shared evidence, ownership, recovery, and Closed read-only behavior.

options.label: Traits-first field slip
options.thesis: Verify the number, add a trait in one action, and capture a short note without changing players.
options.viewport: A number-led identity header sits above applied traits, tag lookup, a compact composer, and Save note.
options.risk: Frequent note writers reach past the trait lookup before entering text.

options.label: Note-first capture
options.thesis: A generous composer makes writing the main action, with traits and history close below.
options.viewport: Compact identity and applied traits lead directly into a generous note field; tag lookup follows the save action.
options.risk: Applying a new trait takes more vertical movement on a short phone screen.

options.label: Shared evidence notebook
options.thesis: Two recent observations give context immediately before an always-visible composer.
options.viewport: Identity, applied traits and compact shared observations sit above the composer, with older history below.
options.risk: Shared observations consume space before writing; their preview must remain tightly bounded.
